outcome: Changes in gut microbial composition between 3 months and 1 year of age
cohort: 166 full-term infants in the Canadian Healthy Infant Longitudinal Development birth cohort
finding: While typical microbial succession patterns were observed in vaginally born, breastfed infants without antibiotic exposure, deviations from this pattern were evident in infants with other perinatal exposures, particularly early cessation of breastfeeding.
